_README: Reference copy of the production login roster. This file is NOT read by the
server — it documents what the Railway env vars should contain. Update it
whenever ADMIN_EMAILS / AUTH_USERS change so the roster is reviewable in git.
Sign-in is work email + PIN. There is no Google SSO.
SESSION_SECRET      = required. Long random string; signs session cookies.
The server REFUSES to boot a deployed instance without
it, because auth would silently be off.
ADMIN_EMAILS        = comma-separated emails -> role admin, scope all.
Admins keep their own email in the audit trail.
AUTH_USERS          = JSON map: work email -> internal associate email.
Keys are lowercased by the server, values must match
BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PIN = temporary. Lets an ADMIN_EMAILS account with no PIN
row sign in and issue everyone else's. REMOVE IT once
the roster below all shows a PIN — while it is set,
that PIN plus a guessable admin address is full admin.
Anyone signing in with an address absent from BOTH lists is turned away at

_OWNERSHIP_AFTER_ALIAS_MERGE._note: Shipments each associate can EDIT (all 26 users can READ all 130).
